clips.title: The story
paras: Kin'weelay seeks a way to rescue young Yenniku from the darkness that has claimed him. Following the revelation of Yenniku's plight, the witch doctor plans to locate a legendary jewel known as the Mind's Eye, sending you to gather resonance shards needed to master its power.

After learning the grim fate that befell Yenniku, the medicine man Kin'weelay turns to ancient jungle lore for an answer. Tales speak of the Mind's Eye, a gem hidden within the depths of Stranglethorn that possesses immense magical strength. Kin'weelay believes this stone could hold the secret to freeing the young troll's spirit. While he communally seeks the guidance of the jungle spirits to pinpoint its location, he needs rare catalysts to safely command the jewel's potent sorcery.

Kin'weelay directs you southeast toward Crystalvein Mine, where ironjaw basilisks dwell beneath the earth. From these creatures, you are to recover three pulsing blue shards. Kin'weelay intends to channel the inherent magic of these singing stones in a concluding ritual, bending the raw might of the Mind's Eye to his command once the gem is recovered.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Legends tell of a jewel, hidden deep in the heart of Stranglethorn. We call it the Mind's Eye, and it has great powers. If you gain this Eye then, perhaps, we can use it to bring lost Yenniku back from the darkness.

I will consult with the spirits of the jungle to find the Mind's Eye. While I do this, you enter the Crystalvein Mine, southeast of here, and gather Pulsing Blue Shards from Ironjaw Basilisks. The shards are rare, but we will need their magic to bend the Mind's Eye to our will.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have the shards, friend? They are needed for my final ritual, after we have the Mind's Eye.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have done well, friend. These shards are well formed. Already I hear them sing to me.
And while you were gone, I spoke with the spirits of the jungle. I know where the Mind's Eye rests...
